faqs.a:
Any member who has 20 or more years of credited service may retire. If such member
               elects to retire, he shall submit his written application to the board setting forth
               what time, neither less than 90 days nor more than 180 days subsequent to the execution
               and filing thereof, he desires to be retired. Such member shall be entitled to a pension
               as provided for in
section 86-75
.
(Code 1960, § 19-7; Code 1981, § 26-61; Ord. No. 3287, §§ 1, 2, 8-19-1996)
